title: [K-Poppin'] "Singlish" Day with DKB(다크비) : Fall in Love from 🎵Thinking Out Loud💭
description:
Learn Korean and English on "Singlish" every Monday!

DKB joins us every week to learn a pop song the listeners chose! Penalties await too!

Every Monday from 1-2pm kst don't forget to join in!

💚 May's Guests: HEECHAN (희찬), TEO(테오), YUKU(유쿠) from DKB(다크비)
💚May's Singlish:  Ed sheeran - thinking out loud ❤️ 

📌Today's expression: sweep, cheeks, ‘til, mysterious, fall in love
